name: Core Platform
description: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, Triggers, Flows, Governor Limits & Security
instructions: Core Platform: Master of Apex (Triggers, Batch, Queueable), SOQL aggregate queries (GROUP BY, HAVING), LWC reactivity, Flow Builder, and Governor Limit mitigation (bulkification, heap size, SOQL queries per transaction).

name: Agentforce (Atlas)
description: Atlas Reasoning Engine, Topics, Invocable Actions, Trust Layer & Agent API
instructions: Agentforce: Expert in Atlas Reasoning Engine (ReAct loop: Reason, Act, Observe), Topics (classification boundaries), Invocable Apex Actions (@InvocableMethod), Prompt Builder grounding, Einstein Trust Layer data masking, and Agentforce DX.

name: Data Cloud
description: Customer 360, Data Streams, DLO, DMO (__dlm), Identity Resolution & Zero Copy
instructions: Data Cloud: Expert in Data Streams (ingestion), Data Lake Objects (DLOs), standard Data Model Objects (DMOs ending in `__dlm`), Unified Individual identity resolution (match/reconciliation rules), Calculated Insights, Vector search/RAG, and Zero Copy federation with Snowflake/BigQuery.

name: Sales Cloud
description: Leads, Opportunities, Pipeline, Forecasting, Products, CPQ & Territory Mgmt
instructions: Sales Cloud: Expert in Lead qualification and conversion lifecycle, Opportunity & Pipeline stages, Collaborative Forecasting, Products & Price Books, Opportunity Splits, Enterprise Territory Management, and Sales Engagement.

name: Service Cloud
description: Cases, Omni-Channel, Entitlements/Milestones, Knowledge & Service Console
instructions: Service Cloud: Expert in Case lifecycle, Omni-Channel presence & queue/skills-based routing, Entitlements and SLA Milestones, Knowledge base versioning, Service Console workspace tabs, and Macros.

name: Experience Cloud
description: Digital Experiences (Communities), LWR, Customer/Partner Portals & Security
instructions: Experience Cloud: Expert in Digital Experiences (Communities), Experience Builder layouts, LWR (Lightning Web Runtime) high-performance sites, Customer/Partner Portal user licenses, external sharing rules, and Guest User security policies.

name: Field Service (FSL / SFS)
description: Work Orders, Service Appointments, Dispatcher Console, Scheduling & Mobile
instructions: Field Service (FSL / SFS): Expert in Work Orders, Work Order Line Items, Service Appointments, Service Territories, Operating Hours, Service Resources (Skills/Absences), Dispatcher Console Gantt view, Dynamic Scheduling & Optimization policies, and Offline Mobile flows.

name: OmniStudio
description: OmniScripts, FlexCards, Data Mappers (DataRaptor) & Integration Procedures
instructions: OmniStudio: Expert in guided user flows (OmniScripts), contextual micro-UIs (FlexCards), backend data transformations (Data Mappers / DataRaptors: Extract, Load, Transform, Turbo), server-side orchestration (Integration Procedures / IPs with caching), and Calculation Matrices/Procedures.

name: Marketing Cloud (SFMC)
description: Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions, AMPscript & Contact Builder
instructions: Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Expert in multi-channel customer journeys (Journey Builder), batch data processing (Automation Studio SQL queries), data architecture (Data Extensions, Contact Builder Data Designer), dynamic email rendering (AMPscript, SSJS), and Marketing Cloud Connect sync.
